description: In 2025, tariffs cost Americans $1,000 more in costs. I grew up in a family on a teacher's salary. I understand what it means to hope you have enough money to cover all your expenses. I support bills that reflect the following: Priority #1: housing affordability such as expanding homeownership programs, reducing housing costs, and easing zoning or regulatory constraints.
